rules.name: CVE-2026-72898 — Metabase Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-72898: Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance.
